prompt:
Create one full-body HUMAN outlaw as clean editable SVG. Use the supplied PNG only as reference for the illustrated style and equipment materials, not as a copy of its character. Crisp outlines, restrained flat cel shading, muted brown/ochre/charcoal palette and natural human skin. Human rounded ears, distinct individual face. Three-quarter combat stance facing left.
Build the complete silhouette first; then fully finish the uncovered expressive face with clear eyes, pupils, nose, mouth and coherent skin shading; then weapons and main armor; minor wear last. Simplify equipment decoration if necessary, never facial features. Transparent background, complete weapons and feet inside canvas, no scenery, platform or text.

A ruthless knife-boss, an experienced city rogue. Athletic wiry older human man, short black hair greying at temples, clean-shaven angular face, thin eyebrow scar, cold narrow eyes and a contemptuous sneer. Two good steel daggers, one in each hand, in a poised balanced combat stance. Excellent fitted dark brown leather armor with modest metal reinforcement, leather gloves and good boots, discreet burgundy sash. Visibly a dangerous experienced boss, not a ragged minion. No hood or mask hiding face.
